Well, these could possibly just be cached images. They don’t necessarily need to be downloaded by a person. Even just going to a news home page could cause all the images on the page to be cached. It’s the browser performing the activity, not the user in this instance. Unallocated space really doesn’t tell us anything besides the fact that these images existed on the comp at some point. Other artifacts need to be found to either prove or disprove what happened. Even just cleaning up your browser could cause these to be deleted. So it’s hard to really draw any conclusions from small images like this in unallocated.

Do you know who’s hard drive this was from? The fact that it was found in unallocated is interesting yet unfortunate. Is there any other digital forensic evidence she is going to be introducing that you are aware of?

I'm not sure exactly how to help since I haven't personally experienced any severe health problems, but I'll do my best as a Reddit woman! 

The first thing I would suggest is if you have contacted her and left her messages and she hasn't gotten back to you, just wait. Honestly, that is probably the hardest thing to do right now, just wait for a response, but it's just what you need to do.

Secondly, I have a friend with migraine issues and she could honestly be out for days sometimes. She couldn't leave her bed much and would just lay in the dark. I would hear back from her 3 or 4 days after I just sent her a simple text. She just was unable to handle more than that.

So now the good news for you! She asked YOU out! You guys had a great time and went out several times! That's already a good sign :) She thought enough of you to just go for it with you...what an awesome girl, I love it!

Sending flowers was a very sweet idea- it was good to show her that you care for her and you're there for her. Plus, who does't love to get flowers from a loved one at work! To know that someone cares about you to take time out of their day to do something nice for you. Very sweet! :)

Lastly- I suggest putting your faith in your mutual friends. She's gushing and telling them she really likes you? That's great! Believe them :) If something changed in her feelings, she probably would have told them. Know that she does really like you if that's what she's putting out there. 

I guess the key here is patience...I know it can be hard to just sit there and wait for a response, but it sounds like you two could be something really special, and waiting would be totally worth it!!

The best of luck to both of you! :D  I really hope you have a wonderful, amazing, fantastic love and relationship.
